Ayatollah Khamenei's funeral further demonstrates that the Iranian government has a robust but minoritarian support base, contrary to Western narratives. What the war has done, in addition, is that it has allowed it to rebuild one pillar of its legitimacy that has been badly bruised in the past few years - its ability to keep the country safe. 

The outcome of the US-Israel war has reversed this trend, which matters as this pillar is also valued in circles outside of the theocracy's core support
